Home / About

Two trades. One family.

Copperleaf Air & Plumbing has served Houston-area homes since 2009.

Ray Medina started Copperleaf in 2009 with one truck and an AC license. His wife Dolores ran the phones from the kitchen table. A few years later we added a master plumber, because customers kept asking us to look at the water heater while we were there.

Today we run a small team of licensed techs across the Houston area. Every truck carries AC and plumbing parts, so most jobs are finished in one visit.

We still answer the phone ourselves, and we still give you the price before we pick up a tool.

How we work

Three rules on every job

  • Price before work
